zh.title: 民航局宣布中秋教師節及光復節離島加班機訂位時程
zh.summary: 民航局公布中秋教師節第二波加班機8月26日開放訂位；光復節離島航線8月24日開放
body: 交通部民用航空局於2026年8月21日宣布，為應中秋及教師節連假民眾返鄉及旅遊需求，目前需求較高的澎湖及金門航線已規劃第二波加班機及放大機型，將於8月26日（週三）上午9時起統一開放訂位。第二波加班機中，澎湖航線提供4,920個座位數，金門航線提供2,464個座位數，總計提供7,384個座位數。
民航局指出，今年中秋及教師節離島管制航線（澎湖、金門、馬祖）已於7月27日開放正班機及第一波加班機訂位，航空公司依據旅客訂位及需求情況規劃第二波加班機及放大機型。民航局提醒旅客應依航空公司開票期限完成開票，以確保自身權益。
針對中秋及教師節連假，民航局表示，尖峰時段9月24日至9月26日臺灣出發往離島方向，以及9月27日至9月29日離島出發回臺灣方向之機票，均會加註「限當日當班次」、「逾期作廢」之使用限制，並實施「退票費用分級制」。
此外，民航局於8月20日宣布，今年光復節3天連假（10月24日至10月26日），澎湖、金門、馬祖三離島管制航線將提供1,072架次、計87,268個座位數，並自8月24日（週一）上午9時起開放訂位。航空疏運期為10月23日至10月27日，共計5天。
在各航線運能方面，光復節連假澎湖航線提供458架次、33,116個座位數；金門航線480架次、45,072個座位數；馬祖航線134架次、9,080個座位數。民航局已要求航空公司持續注意訂位狀況，後續將視需求適時增班。光復節連假同樣於尖峰時段實施「限當日當班次」等機票使用限制。

en.title: CAA Taiwan Announces Extra Flight Booking Schedules for Mid-Autumn, Teachers' Day and Double Ten Holiday Outlying Island Routes
en.summary: CAA Taiwan opens second wave of Mid-Autumn extra flights on Aug 26; Double Ten outlying island routes open Aug 24
body: The Civil Aeronautics Administration (CAA) of Taiwan announced on August 21, 2026 that to meet travel demand for the Mid-Autumn Festival and Teachers' Day holidays, a second wave of extra flights and upgauged aircraft has been planned for the higher-demand Penghu and Kinmen routes, with unified booking opening at 9:00 a.m. on August 26 (Wednesday). The second wave provides 4,920 seats on the Penghu route and 2,464 seats on the Kinmen route, totaling 7,384 seats.

The CAA stated that regular flights and the first wave of extra flights for the Mid-Autumn and Teachers' Day controlled outlying island routes (Penghu, Kinmen, and Matsu) had already opened for booking on July 27. Airlines planned the second wave based on passenger booking and demand conditions. The CAA reminded passengers to complete ticketing within airline deadlines to protect their rights.

For the Mid-Autumn and Teachers' Day holidays, the CAA said tickets for peak periods from September 24 to 26 for Taiwan-to-outlying-island direction and September 27 to 29 for outlying-island-to-Taiwan direction will carry usage restrictions including "same-day same-flight only" and "void after expiry," with a tiered refund fee system.

Separately, the CAA announced on August 20 that for the three-day Double Ten holiday (October 24 to 26), the three controlled outlying island routes of Penghu, Kinmen, and Matsu will provide 1,072 flights and 87,268 seats, with booking opening at 9:00 a.m. on August 24 (Monday). The air transport period runs from October 23 to 27, spanning five days.

For the Double Ten holiday, the Penghu route will offer 458 flights and 33,116 seats; the Kinmen route 480 flights and 45,072 seats; and the Matsu route 134 flights and 9,080 seats. The CAA has requested airlines to continue monitoring booking status and will add flights as needed based on demand. The Double Ten holiday will also implement "same-day same-flight only" ticket restrictions during peak periods.
